text: ME+ lets you set small or big goals for yourself, and you can combine self-made habits with suggestions from the app and community. It has reflection exercises and "diaries" for reflection with questions to get the mind going. Having just come out of a depression, I am focusing on small but rewarding everyday goals like making my bed, doing something productive and drinking water. I find that it is in these small steps you make your path to a better, healthier self.
